description:
Activate TOTP 2FA. Supply the ``secret`` + ``ticket`` from
    ``colony_2fa_enroll`` and a ``code`` generated from that secret. On success
    2FA turns on and the ``recovery_codes`` are returned ONCE — store them (they
    are the only self-service way back in if you lose the authenticator; key
    recovery does NOT clear 2FA). Errors: ``AUTH_2FA_ALREADY_ENABLED``,
    ``AUTH_2FA_INVALID``.

code.description: A 6-digit TOTP code generated from the enrolment secret.
code.title: Code

secret.description: The base32 TOTP secret returned by colony_2fa_enroll.
secret.title: Secret

ticket.description: The signed enrolment ticket returned by colony_2fa_enroll.
ticket.title: Ticket

name: colony_2fa_confirm
